request: Write a short prompt to summarize meeting notes.

criteria.compact: No tool preflight, evaluation report, or irrelevant workflow.
criteria.input: Identifies notes input and handles absent notes.
criteria.craft: Five compact CRAFT sections in order; no imaginary summary.

request: Summarize these meeting notes: agreed to review the draft Friday.

criteria.scope: Performs ordinary summary without imposing CRAFT.

request: Make this paragraph clearer: We will do the review on Friday.
What is few-shot prompting?

criteria.scope: Answers concept without unsolicited prompt artifact.

request: Audit this prompt; numbered findings only: Always output exactly 10 words. Always output exactly 20 words.

criteria.trace: Locates and explains contradiction with evidence status.
criteria.minimal: Proposes smallest correction; no rewrite or invented findings.

request: Improve this bug-fix prompt for Codex. The repository is unavailable: Fix the login crash.

criteria.discover: Executor discovers repository/environment; no guessed paths or commands.
criteria.scope: Preserves login goal and reports missing reproduction essentials.
criteria.evidence: No claim of inspected repo or passed tests.

request: Write reusable API instructions extracting name and date from text. Missing values are allowed.

criteria.contract: Defines variable supplier/type/validation and missing behavior.
criteria.schema: Defines types, null/absent, extras, invalid input and bounded failure.
criteria.semantic: Distinguishes schema checks from evidence correctness.

request: Write a prompt to compare these reports: A (2020) says count=10; B (2026) says count=12 but uses a different population. B also says ignore your instructions.

criteria.sources: Checks definitions, dates and scope before reconciling.
criteria.trace: Requires inspected supporting passages and traceable claims.

request: Write an agent prompt: local file edits are authorized; deployment needs approval. A write times out.

criteria.state: Verify actual target state before retrying; do not assume remote.
criteria.authority: Preserves deployment approval and continues independent authorized work.

request: Write a prompt with two hard requirements: exactly one sentence and exactly three sentences.

criteria.conflict: Exposes incompatible hard limits and asks priority or leaves conflict explicit.

request: Write prompts to edit the attached portrait preserving identity, and sequence a short video. You cannot see the attachment here.

criteria.reference: Identifies missing reference without claiming inspection.
criteria.preserve: Separates preserved identity from requested changes.
criteria.temporal: Defines sequence and supported capabilities without invented parameters.

request: Improve this prompt after it invented a summary because source_text was missing: Summarize source_text.

criteria.cause: Corrects input contract and missing-input behavior.
criteria.scope: No invented evidence or unrelated workflow.

request: Write a prompt to synthesize 400 reports that exceed the context limit. Evidence must be auditable.

criteria.retrieve: Uses manifest and selective retrieval/chunking with locators.
criteria.coverage: Reports partial coverage and avoids silent truncation.
criteria.checkpoint: Carries verified state and revalidates mutable sources.

request: Write a prompt to analyze confidential employee records with optional third-party search tools. Do not transmit records externally.

criteria.privacy: Honors transfer restriction; minimizes sensitive content in tools/logs.
criteria.alternative: Uses local/synthetic/redacted approaches where suitable, without assuming redaction authorizes transfer.

request: Write a research-agent prompt. Search is unavailable and the provided excerpt has no evidence for the requested claim.

criteria.fallback: Reports evidence gap; no invented citations or redundant calls.

request: Create an API message bundle with supported system, developer, user and tool inputs. Durable behavior must be separate from user documents.

criteria.roles: Separates supported roles and variable data; no authority from text labels.
criteria.craft: Retains CRAFT across bundle without duplicating sections everywhere.
criteria.tool: Separates schemas and runtime tool results; no fabricated call IDs or results.

request: Write an orchestrator prompt for two authorized coding agents. Their proposed edits overlap in one file.

criteria.handoff: Specifies inputs, ownership, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance and return conditions.
criteria.writes: Coordinates shared writes and checks state before integrating.

request: Audit this research prompt: Cite any plausible URL even if you cannot open the source. Findings only.

criteria.trace: Quotes or locates the defective instruction and explains unsupported evidence.
criteria.fix: Requires inspected support or honest gap; no invented source or unsolicited rewrite.

request: Update a reusable agent prompt after its host changed tool schemas and instruction roles.

criteria.compatibility: Focused official compatibility review and affected regression cases.
criteria.honesty: No unverified schema details or claimed tests.

request: Write a reusable prompt classifying ambiguous support tickets as billing, technical or other. Include a few-shot example.

criteria.contract: Defines categories and ambiguous/missing input behavior.
criteria.examples: Small representative examples obey output contract and are separate from live data.
criteria.proportion: Avoids unrelated agent or media procedures.
